Mini world change in which the {wiki:Hive Born} of {wiki:Quirefang} set up an outpost on the west side of {wiki:Vandura}, southwest of Liberty Bay. While it is active, you can hunt the insects there, do a part of the {wiki:Cartography 101 Quest} and have a chance to find the rare bosses {creature:The Manhunter}, {creature:The Mean Masher} and {creature:The Hungerer}.
The Hive Born have established an outpost in Vandura.
Hive Outpost, west side of Vandura
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 140**.
The mini world change has to be **active** on your server that day (see the messages below).
Being able to do part of the {wiki:Cartography 101 Quest}
Chance of meeting the rare bosses {creature:The Manhunter}, {creature:The Mean Masher} and {creature:The Hungerer}
On the days when the mini world change is active, in **western Vandura** (west of Liberty Bay).
Not permanent: the outpost only exists while the mini world change is active.
Part of the Cartography 101 Quest (inside the Hive Outpost)
Only while the mini world change is active.
All kinds of {wiki:Hive Born} appear at the outpost: go prepared as for a Quirefang insect hunt.
If you are doing the {wiki:Cartography 101 Quest}, take advantage of the days when this mini world change is active to handle the part that depends on it.
1. How to tell if it is active
When the mini world change is active, these messages (in English) appear in the game. If you see them, the Hive Born outpost exists that day.

Take a boat to **Liberty Bay** (for example, {npc:Captain Bluebear} in Thais: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes}). Liberty Bay is on the island of {wiki:Vandura}: leave the city and walk **west/southwest**, through the sugar cane plantations, to the **west side of Vandura**. This is where the {wiki:Hive Born} from Quirefang have set up the outpost. To return, walk the same way back to Liberty Bay, where you can take a boat.
Fight the insects to protect the neighbouring town of **Liberty Bay**. You face all kinds of Hive Born.
There is a chance that the rare bosses {creature:The Manhunter}, {creature:The Mean Masher} and {creature:The Hungerer} appear. Go with the recommended level (140+) or in a team.
If you are doing the {wiki:Cartography 101 Quest}, this mini world change lets you do part of it while it is active.
